_metadata.description: Rights and scoped visual qualification. First-release contract; completion follows requirement-linked behavior and retained protocol evidence.

requirements.title: The library shall verify rights for actual dependency bytes.
requirements.description: Before reusable release or editable export, the system shall record source, author, pinned bytes, license and attribution/change obligations for model, textures, media, fonts and references and reject unsupported intended reuse.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-REVIEW-RIGHTS protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.

metadata.planned_automation: Rights-policy decision fixtures and package attribution audit.

requirements.title: The review shall bind physical evidence to use scope.
requirements.description: The physical review shall report component/configuration bounds, calibrated silhouette/landmark comparisons, held-out views, rig/mount clearance and known unknowns against declared per-shot thresholds.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-REVIEW-PHYSICAL protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.

metadata.planned_automation: Reference/measurement and motion-sweep checks with attended verdict.

requirements.title: The release shall require final-profile visual acceptance.
requirements.description: Before release of a device/scene/motion recipe, a reviewer shall inspect actual final-profile stills and continuous motion for silhouette, materials, lighting, contact, readability, reflections and temporal defects against the selected benchmark.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-REVIEW-CRAFT protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.

metadata.planned_automation: Attended art-direction protocol with accepted/rejected comparison evidence.

requirements.title: The export shall retain separately qualified portable behavior.
requirements.description: When native or portable packages are exported, the system shall pin dependency closure, rights, scale, screen mapping and retained material/rig behavior and reimport or target-viewer-check the promised format.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-REVIEW-PORTABLE protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.

requirements.title: The system shall preserve shared publication ownership.
requirements.description: When an accepted asset is proposed for shared publication, Device Studio shall pass provenance and scoped physical/craft review to Asset Studio without cloning generic asset identity, release state or byte authority.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-REVIEW-PUBLICATION protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.
